On Sun, 18 Oct 2026 at 09:12 Maria Ortega <maria.ortega@cloudserve.io> wrote:
> Our legal/procurement teams ran a quick pass on the DPA and attached initial redlines...

Hi Maria — thanks for the initial redlines. I reviewed and here are concise, trackable proposals that should address both parties' operational needs while keeping our compliance posture intact.

1) Backup/DR carveout language (proposed):
"Notwithstanding any deletion obligations in this Agreement, Redwood may retain Customer Data in backup and disaster recovery copies for a period not to exceed 180 days following deletion or termination, solely for the purposes of restoration in the event of data loss, disaster recovery, or forensic investigation. Such backup copies will be encrypted and access-limited; Redwood will, upon documented Customer request, expunge recoverable copies within commercially reasonable timeframes where no legal hold applies."

Rationale: 180 days balances operational recovery needs and CloudServe's request for a finite bound. We can bake in a shorter operational SLA (e.g., searchable indices removed within 30 days) while snapshots remain for 180 days. If CloudServe insists on 365 days, we can accept but need explicit commitment on encryption/KMS and regional residency.

2) Deletion timeline (proposed):
"Upon termination or Customer-initiated deletion, Redwood will: (a) remove Customer-accessible data within 30 days; (b) purge recoverable copies from primary storage within 90 days; (c) expire backup/DR snapshots as described above within 180 days, except to the extent retention is required by applicable law or documented legal hold."

3) Subprocessor / cross-border backup transfers:
We confirm that backups may be stored in multiple regions for resilience. For EU personal data, Redwood will rely on Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and adequate transfer measures where applicable; we will include a subprocessor disclosure schedule and notify of any new major subprocessor locations 30 days prior to processing.

Attachment: Redwood_DPA_Proposed_Redlines.docx (contains tracked changes).
DocuSign: we will prepare the final PDF after we agree language.

Happy to hop on a quick call if you want to resolve the 180 vs 365 day question.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
